summary: International Media Acquisition Corp. (IMAQ), a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting an amended and restated merger agreement to combine with VCI Holdings and Vietnam Biofuels Development. The restructured deal involves a share purchase where VCI shareholders receive 98M Class A and 2M Class B ordinary shares of the Purchaser (Valix Limited) for all VCI shares. Afterward, Merger Sub merges into IMAQ, making it a Purchaser subsidiary, followed by redomestication to a BVI company. IMAQ's board unanimously approved. This SPAC de-SPAC transaction includes earnout provisions of up to 27M Class A shares. Watch for shareholder vote and regulatory timelines.
